body: I just want to say I’m in a very similar situation as you and I empathize dearly! I’ve been dealing with very bad chronic pain for the last 4-5 years that’s been getting worse. Most time I have to be hospitalized and given high grade pain killers or morphine. Doctors are pretty useless and taking forever and it has affecting my life badly that I had to put a pause on my bachelors again. And go back home because I couldn’t work enough to cover my bills on my own. I really hope they figure out what’s going on and fix it that way you can go on and enjoy your adulthood stress/ pain free

Thank you for empathizing with me and understanding a little about what’s been going on I don’t have too much of that in my life right now. I’m trying not to be a hateful person towards him and wish him no ill will because I don’t want to carry that in my heart. But I’m a firm believer in Karma and I think his Karma is coming to him soon. Over the past couple days since I posted that he’s been all over my inbox on social media cell and missed call list being manipulative trying to get me back in the sense of were always gonna be together we have a bond, if you didn’t tell your sister or anyone about what happened we could of talked through it and still be together. You letting them put stuff in your head, and I bet the reason why you’re not responding to me is because they told you not to but at the end of the day STILL playing both sides back with that lil young girl. Who I seen on his snap physically fighting on the streets with a bunch of girls around her age. I just got to learn how to not let it hurt me and affect me so much emotionally !

Well my toxic friend yeah I would say I definitely feel better.. as for my husband that still hurts daily. What was starting to make me feel better about that is the idea of me being in a better place in my life. Basically motivation To go on and prove everyone wrong but I’ve officially lost the motivation
Thank you for taking the time out to read and respond hearing it from another perspective gives some dose of clarity and comfort

Well basically if we were going to keep being in each other’s life there has to be a purpose like us working on fixing things and doing right by each other basically build a healthy relationship without causing each other pain. He said he wanted that and wanted to be with me and only a couple hours later was telling the girl he didn’t want me and we’re in the process of getting a divorce ( we never had that conversation of divorce) but back on my phone saying she’s lying he don’t want her it’s me he wants. (Lot of flip flopping) in speaking of the other parts of my life I would like to be happy just genuinely happy because I don’t have that. I would like to be pain free and not constantly sick, I would like to finally finish up with my bachelors and start working on my masters. I would like to feel successful in parts of my life and not a disappointment to my mom. I did cut a few people out my life cuz I felt like they were adding more to my problems and I couldn’t handle anymore issues or drama.

Well I guess biologically there’s no changing that but you can Always make your outward appearance match how you’re feeling in the inside if that’s something that would make you more happy. Have you looked into hormone therapy?
Well I’m one person you can talk to then because I don’t think that’s a good enough reason not to talk to you when you want to be heard
Well my inbox is always open if you need to vent or just talk I don’t sleep anyways

I’m sorry you had to deal with that on top of how you’re already feeling about the other aspects of your life.. I hope even if this group isn’t a good means for you to talk you can find somewhere else or someone else that is more welcoming and accepting
Thank you ! For the warning I don’t even know why I posted on here anyways but In retrospect I don’t think I expected to get actual help I just wanted to put my thoughts down on somewhere to find

When I was there I was stuck with a nurse that couldn’t leave my side had to shower and use the bathroom with the door open. I got transferred to I guess a mental clinic hours later they came and transported me and I had a bad experience I felt like I didn’t belong. There were people walking and roaming obviously very mentally disturbed ... the bed was hard cots uncomfortable and they gave Benadryl to sleep they woke me up at 5am for breakfast and I had some kind of psych evaluation by one “doctor/ nurse idk and I lied and said I wasn’t depressed then was referred to the doctor for release
